query:
INSERT INTO devices (name, slug, kind, model, notes, active, platform_id, status,
                               region, condition, store_id, purchased_on, price, currency,
                               estimated_value, estimated_currency, serial_number, barcode)
           VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
           RETURNING id AS "id!"
